```{r}
#| label: get_urls
#| include: false

# Get list of Git info:
info <- gert::git_info()

# Get github-url to repo:
remotes      <- gert::git_remote_list()
url          <- remotes$url[remotes$name == "origin"]
url          <- gsub("\\.git$", "", url)
pre_dbl_url  <- paste0(url, "/releases/tag/pre-dbl-v1.0")
post_dbl_url <- paste0(url, "/releases/tag/post-dbl-v1.0")
commit_url   <- paste0(url, "/tree/", info$commit)
diff_url     <- paste0(url, "/compare/pre-dbl-v1.0...post-dbl-v1.0")
# citation_url <- paste0(url, "/blob/main/CITATION.cff")
# renvlock_url <- paste0(url, "/blob/main/renv.lock")

# Get tags for releases (pre- and post-dbl):
tags <- gert::git_tag_list()
setDT(tags)
tag_here <- "none"
if(nrow(tags) > 0) tag_here <- tags$name[tags$commit == info$commit]

pre_dbl_SHA  <- tags[name == "pre-dbl-v1.0", commit]
post_dbl_SHA <- tags[name == "post-dbl-v1.0", commit]

# Make compare-url 2 previous tag or SHA:
compare2prev <- function(prev, current = gert::git_info()$commit) {
  paste0(url, "/compare/", prev, "...", current)
}
# compare2prev("pre-dbl-v1.0")

# Versions (write out in text for each release):
quarto_v <- as.character(quarto::quarto_version())
pandoc_v <- as.character(rmarkdown::pandoc_version())
R.version.string

```



# Changelog

**Changes to the analysis code and results for the DEXA-PSYCH trial are documented here.**

- Pre-specified and pre-programmed results of the statistical analyses for the DEXA-PSYCH trial are available in in browsable web-books containing the so-called Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLF-books).
- Additional post-hoc results will be made available when produced.
- Archived code or results are never edited, tags are not moved, archived books are not replaced, and corrections appear as new releases.


**Releases are labelled by the kind of change:**

| Type        | Meaning                                             | Version  |
|---          |---                                                  |---       |
| Maintenance | Code or environment changes. Results are unchanged. | `v1.0.x` |
| Addition    | New results. Existing results are unchanged.        | `v1.x.0` |
| Correction  | Visible changes to presented results.               | `vx.0.0` |


## `v1.0.1`---`r Sys.Date()` (tag [unreleased](`r commit_url`))

- **Type:** Maintenance 
- **Additions:** None
- **Major changes:** None
- **Minor changes:** 
  - Add Changelog to repo.
- **Effect on results:** None 
  - Reproducibility checks showed no differences to `post-dbl-v1.0`.
- **Commit:** [`r info$commit`](`r commit_url`)
- **Changes to code:** [compare-view](`r compare2prev("post-dbl-v1.0")`)
- **Environment:** R version 4.5.2 (2025-10-31 ucrt), Quarto 1.9.38, Pandoc 3.8.3.


## `v1.0.0`---2026-10-23 (tag [post-dbl-v1.0](`r post_dbl_url`))

- **Type:** Baseline---first post-database-lock release.
- **Summary:** Analysis code as used for the post-DBL analyses. 
- **Commit:** [`r post_dbl_SHA`](`r paste0(url, "/tree/", post_dbl_SHA)`)
- **Changes to code:** [compare-view](`r diff_url`)
- **Zenodo code archive:** <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23587985>
- **Environment:** R version 4.5.2 (2025-10-31 ucrt), Quarto 1.9.38, Pandoc 3.8.3.
